usersPage.manageUserAccountsApprovalStatusAnd: Manage user accounts, approval status, and role assignments.
usersPage.willBeRemovedFromTheUsers: will be removed from the users list and can no longer sign in. Their course history, certificates and audit records are kept, and their email can be registered again.

bulkRegisterPage.importACsvOfUserAccounts: Import a CSV of user accounts. Accounts are created approved and active; duplicate emails are skipped.
bulkRegisterPage.columnsFirstNameLastNameEmail: Columns: first_name, last_name, email, phone (required) and password, tin, role (optional). A blank password is auto-generated, a blank role means Learner.
bulkRegisterPage.columnsAreMatchedByHeaderName: Columns are matched by header name, so their order doesn't matter. Roles accepted: {value}. Tip: if you edit the file in Excel, format the phone and tin columns as Text so leading zeros are kept.
bulkRegisterPage.chooseACsvFileAboveTo: Choose a CSV file above to preview its contents before creating accounts.
bulkRegisterPage.reviewAndFixTheImportedRecords: Review and fix the imported records, then tick the rows to register. Rows with errors are not sent.
bulkRegisterPage.belowIsTheConfirmationOfThe: Below is the confirmation of the records created.
bulkRegisterPage.passwordsAreShownOnlyOnceDownload: Passwords are shown only once. Download the credentials now and share them securely with each user.
bulkRegisterPage.name: Name
bulkRegisterPage.rowSSkippedTheyAreStill: {count} row(s) skipped — they are still in the preview above so you can fix and resend them.
bulkRegisterPage.passwordsLeftBlankAreAutoGenerated: Passwords left blank are auto-generated to meet the password policy. On first sign-in, each user receives an emailed code and must set their own password. Up to 500 users per import.
bulkRegisterPage.rowsWithErrorsOne: {count} selected row has errors and won't be sent until fixed.
bulkRegisterPage.rowsWithErrorsOther: {count} selected rows have errors and won't be sent until fixed.

registerActorPage.manuallyRegisterAUserWithAny: Manually register a user with any role. The account is created already approved and active — no approval queue.
registerActorPage.linkingATrainerToTheirPrimary: Linking a trainer to their primary branch helps auto-populate venues when scheduling in-person sessions.
registerActorPage.requirePasswordChangeOnFirstSign: Require password change on first sign-in (sends email code)

rolesPermissionsPage.toggleExactlyWhatEachRoleCan: Toggle exactly what each role can do. Changes apply to everyone with that role within ~15 seconds — no redeploy, no re-login.
rolesPermissionsPage.selectARoleToViewOr: Select a role to view or edit its permissions.
rolesPermissionsPage.configureCustomRoleIdentifiersAndAssign: Configure custom role identifiers and assign granular RBAC permissions.
rolesPermissionsPage.uniqueUppercaseIdentifierUsedByBackend: Unique uppercase identifier used by backend authorization guards.
rolesPermissionsPage.humanReadableTitleShownInUser: Human-readable title shown in user directory and role badges.
rolesPermissionsPage.areYouSureYouWantTo: Are you sure you want to delete role
rolesPermissionsPage.thisActionCannotBeUndoneAnd: This action cannot be undone and will revoke permissions for all users assigned to this role.

permissions.course:delete: Delete course (Owner: DRAFT only, enforced in service layer)
permissions.question_bank:manage: Access and manage the question bank (create, edit, delete questions)
permissions.CERTIFICATE_MANAGE: Manage, search, preview, verify, and revoke issued certificates
permissions.CERTIFICATE_TEMPLATE_MANAGE: Create, edit, preview, activate, and archive certificate templates
permissions.course_policy:manage: Manage course completion policy (time-spent %, retake cooldown)
permissions.category:manage: Manage dynamic categories (course categories, levels, question types)
